content.title: Watch the Trail Blazers vs Spurs NBA Playoffs Game 1 streaming free tonight; TV channel, time, odds
content.text: Deni Avdija #8 celebrates a basket with teammate Scoot Henderson #00 of the Portland Trail Blazers during the second half against the San Antonio Spurs at Moda Center on December 13, 2024, in Portland, Oregon. (Photo by Soobum Im/Getty Images)Getty ImagesIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveTonight’s prime time game features the Portland Trail Blazers taking on Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs in Game 1 of their NBA Playoffs series. The tip is scheduled for 6 p.m. PT/9 p.m. ET (7 p.m. MST) on Sunday, April 18, and you can watch live on NBC as well as stream it on Peacock.What TV channel is the Trail Blazers vs. Spurs NBA Playoff game on tonight, or is it streaming only?Tonight’s game is available on regular broadcast TV via NBC, and is also available to live stream on Peacock, NBC’s flagship streaming service. When: 10:15 a.m. PT/1:15 p.m. ET (11:15 a.m. MST) on Tuesday, March 26Where: Frost Bank Center in San Antonio, TXTV channel: NBC, and streaming on PeacockHow to watch the game streaming live: You can watch this game today live for FREE with DirecTV (free trial).Another great option might be to check out the multitude of subscription options at Sling and buy an HDTV antenna. You can also sign up for Peacock Premium ($10.99/month) to watch this game live on your TV, computer, phone, or tablet with the Peacock app. To sign up, follow the sign-up instructions on the Peacock home page, and it will walk you through how to sign up quickly.
